name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP ration cuts; Sudan shelter aid at 10%
summary: WFP halved Gaza rations; UN says Sudan shelter aid reaches only 10% of those in need; no full suspension
state: WFP said on 19 Oct that funding shortfalls forced it to halve food rations in Gaza and cut its monthly reach from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people (Reuters via TimesLIVE). On 6 Nov the UN said only about 10% of the 15.4 million people in Sudan needing emergency shelter could be prioritised, and IOM said its Sudan warehouses were empty (Reuters via bdnews24). Major ration cuts meet Watch; no formal large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country was found as of 16 Nov.
for_you: Funding gaps fall hardest on people in Gaza, Sudan and other crises who rely on rations. Readers who want to help can find vetted appeals through the UK Disasters Emergency Committee or UN agencies.
rubric_hit: Major ration cuts announced (WFP Gaza, Sudan) meet Watch; no large-scale suspension in famine-risk countries for Alert

sources.title: TimesLIVE (Reuters) — World Food Programme cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza
bdnews24 (Reuters) — Millions of displaced Sudanese risk losing shelter as funds run low, UN warns

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
